patterns.note: The site uses a full-width dark theme with distinct horizontal sections, each featuring a title and a scrollable carousel of content cards.
A high-contrast dark mode is consistently applied, using a deep charcoal background with white text and prominent gold/tan accents for interactive elements and highlights.
Headings are large and bold sans-serif, providing clear hierarchy against the dark background, while body text is smaller and clean for readability.
A 'Access Restricted' notification remains sticky in the bottom-right corner of the viewport as the user scrolls, while the main header scrolls out of view.
All content sections (e.g., 'Live Wins', 'Live Casino') follow a consistent structure: a left-aligned title, a 'See all' link, navigation arrows, and a horizontal grid of rounded-corner game cards.

technique_notes: The site establishes a premium, dynamic feel using a full-bleed video hero background with a dark overlay to ensure text legibility. The video plays automatically, setting an immediate immersive tone.

Content is organized into distinct horizontal carousels within full-width sections, allowing users to browse numerous items without excessive vertical scrolling. Navigation arrows provide explicit control over the carousel movement.

The primary motion effect is a sticky element (the 'Access Restricted' notice) that remains fixed in the viewport, providing persistent information regardless of scroll depth. Other elements scroll naturally with the page without complex scroll-triggered reveals or parallax, relying on the video hero for initial dynamism.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3x body) create strong section breaks, with smaller, clean body text and very fine legal disclaimers.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are consistently applied to buttons, content cards, and notification elements, softening the overall aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing between major sections, with a tighter grid and minimal padding within horizontal content carousels to maximize visible items.

standout: The immediate impact of the full-width, auto-playing video hero creates a highly immersive and dynamic first impression, effectively conveying the site's entertainment focus. This, combined with the consistent dark theme and gold accents, establishes a distinct premium casino atmosphere.
